title: Joshua 2:21 — scarlet cord in the window; tikvah (cord), shani (scarlet)
summary: Joshua 2:21 in English and Hebrew: Rahab ties the scarlet cord in the window. Scarlet (red) and cord (gold) are colour-coded to the Hebrew words השני and תקות, followed by tikvah (תקוה, cord) and shani (שני, scarlet), over a faint red cord in the background.

text.text: 21 She said, “According to your words, so be it.” So she sent them away, and they departed; and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
21 ותאמר כדבריכם כן־הוא ותשלחם וילכו ותקשר את־תקות השני בחלון׃

pictures.description: A faint, translucent pink-red twisted cord winding in waves across the lower half of the slide behind the labels, from the lower left up over the middle and down to the lower right.

keywords: tied the scarlet cord in the window
according to your words so be it
uncertain: The slide gives tikvah (תקוה) as the word for 'Cord'; in the verse the Hebrew shows the form תקות, read as the same word.
